d.d: A native or inhabitant of Uzbekistan.

A member of a Central Asian Turkic ethnic group native to Uzbekistan and neighboring countries, with significant, centuries-old indigenous populations across northern Afghanistan, Tajikistan, and Kyrgyzstan.
Of, from, or pertaining to Uzbekistan, the Uzbek people or the Uzbek language.
A country in Central Asia. Official name: Republic of Uzbekistan. Capital: Tashkent.
